author: Megaprojects
description:
China's GJ-11 Sharp Sword is a jet-powered stealth combat drone designed to attack enemy air defences without a pilot aboard. Development began in the 1990s, with the first flight in November 2013. Recent footage shows it flying alongside J-20 fighters, while a naval variant appears destined for catapult-equipped assault ships.
